tables.description: One row per trial from ClinicalTrials.gov: industry-sponsored, interventional, phase 2 or 3, primary completion 2015 to 2023.

columns.name: nct_id
columns.description: ClinicalTrials.gov ID, e.g. NCT01234567. Primary key; joins every other table.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Brief title of the trial.

columns.name: sponsor
columns.description: Lead sponsor name exactly as registered. Use ILIKE '%name%' to match: spelling varies.

columns.name: sponsor_class
columns.description: Lead sponsor class. Always INDUSTRY in this snapshot.

columns.name: phase
columns.description: Phase, e.g. PHASE2, PHASE3, or PHASE2/PHASE3 for combined trials.

columns.name: conditions
columns.description: List of conditions studied (VARCHAR[]). Search with list_contains or array_to_string(conditions, ' ') ILIKE.

columns.name: interventions
columns.description: List of intervention names (VARCHAR[]), including placebo and devices.

columns.name: drug_names
columns.description: Drug and biologic intervention names without placebo (VARCHAR[]). Use these to search filings.

columns.name: overall_status
columns.description: Registry status: TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, SUSPENDED or COMPLETED.

columns.name: why_stopped
columns.description: The sponsor's free-text reason for stopping, as registered. NULL when completed or left blank.

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: Trial start date (month-only dates become the 1st).

columns.name: primary_completion_date
columns.description: Date the last participant was examined for the primary outcome.

columns.name: completion_date
columns.description: Date the whole trial ended.

columns.name: enrollment
columns.description: Number of participants enrolled (actual for stopped trials).

columns.name: has_results
columns.description: TRUE if summary results are posted on ClinicalTrials.gov.

columns.name: results_first_post_date
columns.description: Date results were first posted. NULL if never posted.

columns.name: last_update_date
columns.description: Date the registry record was last updated.

tables.description: Derived columns per trial, built by scripts/build_snapshot.py. Join on nct_id.

columns.name: nct_id
columns.description: Trial ID; joins trials.nct_id.

columns.name: results_due_date
columns.description: Approximate results deadline: primary completion + 365 days. An approximation, not a legal deadline. NULL for trials that never enrolled anyone (all WITHDRAWN trials): they have no results to post.

columns.name: results_posted
columns.description: TRUE if results are posted on ClinicalTrials.gov.

columns.name: days_late
columns.description: If posted: days after results_due_date it was posted (0 = on time). If not posted and past due: days overdue as of the snapshot date. NULL otherwise.

columns.name: stopped
columns.description: TRUE if status is TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN or SUSPENDED.

columns.name: why_stopped_category
columns.description: Category of the stated reason: safety, efficacy, business/strategic, enrollment, other, or blank.

columns.name: why_stopped_method
columns.description: How the category was assigned: keyword, llm, blank, or default.

tables.description: Sponsor name to SEC CIK for publicly listed sponsors. Private sponsors have no row.

columns.name: sponsor
columns.description: Sponsor name as in trials.sponsor.

columns.name: cik
columns.description: SEC Central Index Key, 10 digits zero-padded.

columns.name: ticker
columns.description: Stock ticker. NULL for a filer that is no longer listed (acquired, renamed or delisted).

columns.name: company
columns.description: Company name as SEC has it.

columns.name: match_score
columns.description: Similarity 0 to 100 of the full normalized names. Informational: every row already has an identical core name (or is an override).

columns.name: match_method
columns.description: How it matched: exact_core (identical core name in SEC's listed companies), edgar_name (EDGAR company search, for filers no longer listed), override (subsidiary mapped to the parent that files).

columns.name: sic
columns.description: SEC Standard Industrial Classification code of the filer, e.g. 2834 pharmaceutical preparations.

columns.name: files_8k
columns.description: TRUE if the filer files 8-Ks. FALSE for foreign private issuers, which report on 6-K instead, so an empty filings result for them is expected.

tables.description: SEC 8-K filings from a matched sponsor within 120 days of a stopped trial's primary completion, completion or last update date that mention its NCT ID or drug name. Up to 3 per trial, most relevant first.

columns.name: nct_id
columns.description: Trial the filing was matched to.

columns.name: cik
columns.description: Filer's CIK.

columns.name: accession
columns.description: SEC accession number, e.g. 0001193125-21-123456.

columns.name: form
columns.description: Form type, e.g. 8-K.

columns.name: filed_date
columns.description: Date filed with the SEC.

columns.name: url
columns.description: URL of the matching document in the EDGAR archive.

columns.name: matched_terms
columns.description: Search terms used (NCT ID and drug names).

columns.name: snippet
columns.description: About 600 characters of plain text from the filing: the most relevant passage for this trial (see relevance). NULL if the document could not be read.

columns.name: relevance
columns.description: How closely the snippet is tied to this trial: nct_id (names the NCT ID), drug_and_stop (drug name near stop or outcome language such as terminated, discontinued, primary endpoint, topline), drug_and_condition (drug name near the trial's condition), drug_only (drug name only, often a sales table or pipeline chart: weakest).

tables.description: PubMed articles linked to a trial.

columns.name: nct_id
columns.description: Trial ID.

columns.name: pmid
columns.description: PubMed ID.

columns.name: link_type
columns.description: How it was linked: ctgov_result (sponsor listed it as a results paper), ctgov_derived or pubmed_si (the article lists the NCT ID), europepmc_mention (text mentions the NCT ID). Only ctgov_result, pubmed_si and ctgov_derived with pub_date on or after the trial's start_date can be a results paper; europepmc_mention is almost always a review that only names the trial, so never count it as published.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Article title.

columns.name: journal
columns.description: Journal name.

columns.name: pub_date
columns.description: Publication date.

columns.name: url
columns.description: PubMed URL.

tables.description: Registry reason vs. 8-K language, one row per stopped trial and linked 8-K (drug_only snippets skipped). Built by keyword rules in ghost/discrepancy.py from the filings snippet. A discrepancy is a difference between two public statements, not evidence of intent.

columns.name: nct_id
columns.description: Trial ID.

columns.name: sponsor
columns.description: Sponsor as registered.

columns.name: registry_reason
columns.description: why_stopped text from the registry, exactly as registered.

columns.name: registry_category
columns.description: trial_derived.why_stopped_category for the trial.

columns.name: registry_evidence_id
columns.description: Evidence id of the registry side, e.g. ctgov:NCT01234567.

columns.name: accession
columns.description: SEC accession number of the 8-K.

columns.name: filed_date
columns.description: Date the 8-K was filed.

columns.name: filing_url
columns.description: URL of the 8-K document.

columns.name: sec_evidence_id
columns.description: Evidence id of the 8-K side, e.g. sec:0001193125-23-231951.

columns.name: sec_quote
columns.description: The 8-K sentence the label rests on, an exact substring of the filing text. NULL when no sentence gives a reason.

columns.name: sec_categories
columns.description: Reasons the quote states: efficacy (a failure such as 'did not meet the primary endpoint'), safety (a concern such as 'clinical hold'), business/strategic, enrollment, positive (a success such as 'met its primary endpoint').

columns.name: scope
columns.description: What the quote is about: this_trial (names the NCT ID or the trial's acronym), drug_program (names only the drug), other_trial (names a different trial).

columns.name: relevance
columns.description: The filing's relevance label from the filings table.

columns.name: label
columns.description: discrepancy (8-K gives efficacy or safety where the registry gives another reason, or the reverse), consistent, registry_blank_8k_reason, different_reason, no_reason_in_8k, about_another_trial.

columns.name: rule
columns.description: The rule that set the label, e.g. 'registry business/strategic; 8-K efficacy'.

columns.name: decided_by
columns.description: How the label was decided: keyword_rules_v1 (deterministic rules), or hand_checked after a person read the filing.

columns.name: strength
columns.description: 0 to 10, discrepancies only: higher when the 8-K names this trial, gives efficacy or safety, the registry explicitly rules that reason out, and the 8-K is close to the stop date.

columns.name: days_from_stop
columns.description: Days between the 8-K and the nearest of the trial's primary completion, completion or last update date.

tables.description: One row per table: when the snapshot was built and how many rows each table has.

columns.name: table_name
columns.description: Table name.

columns.name: row_count
columns.description: Rows in that table.

columns.name: built_at
columns.description: Snapshot build date (UTC).

columns.name: scope
columns.description: What the snapshot covers.
enum_values: ClinicalTrials.gov industry-sponsored interventional phase 2/3 trials, primary completion 2015-01-01 to 2023-12-31, status TERMINATED/WITHDRAWN/SUSPENDED/COMPLETED
